journeys.scenario: Mina pays or receives a spend signal, ChopDot captures the money moment, Mina reviews it, the group split is created, requests are sent, payments are confirmed, and the record closes without losing receipt truth.

deadEnds.title: Request sent removes correction path
deadEnds.problem: After Mina sends a payment request, she can lose the ability to add a forgotten expense.
deadEnds.expected: The group remains open and Add expense remains available until the record is closed.

activeOwner.note: Programme A owns portable-shell behavior and host proof. P-026 consumes its evidence only.

deadEnds.title: Premature close action
deadEnds.problem: Finish/close can appear while money is still owed.
deadEnds.expected: Close appears only when required items are resolved or explicitly classified.

activeOwner.note: P-025 owns canonical integration, payment authority, actor authority, and security reconciliation.

deadEnds.title: Normal settlement state model cannot express off-happy states
deadEnds.problem: Normal settlement supports pending, paid, confirmed only.
deadEnds.expected: Normal obligations support delayed, waived, disputed, rejected, expired, duplicate, and wrong-payment paths or explicit fallbacks.

deadEnds.title: Backend confirmation can auto-close before readable closeout
deadEnds.problem: Final confirmation can mark the pot completed before user-visible closeout review.
deadEnds.expected: Confirmation moves to all_items_resolved; close record remains a separate review action.

activeOwner.note: P-025 owns canonical integration, payment authority, actor authority, and security reconciliation.

deadEnds.title: Close with note can hide unresolved money
deadEnds.problem: Freeform note can substitute for explicit delayed, waived, disputed, or unresolved classification.
deadEnds.expected: Each open item has a visible resolution type before saved history.

deadEnds.title: Settle flow blurs request and mark-paid meanings
deadEnds.problem: SettleHome says Mark paid/received while creating pending settlement legs.
deadEnds.expected: Request/propose, mark paid, receiver confirm, and close are separate states.

deadEnds.title: Partial payment has no normal-pot representation
deadEnds.problem: No first-class partial amount, remaining balance, or partial confirmation state exists in normal settlement.
deadEnds.expected: Partial payment confirms only received amount and leaves remainder open, delayed, or waived.

activeOwner.note: P-025 owns canonical integration, payment authority, actor authority, and security reconciliation.

deadEnds.title: Member changes after request are unproven
deadEnds.problem: Membership changes after requests or settlement legs exist are not mapped/proven.
deadEnds.expected: Member changes create safe review/follow-up states without mutating sent requests or orphaning obligations.

deadEnds.title: Wrong-payment proof is lane-specific
deadEnds.problem: Wrong-currency/missing-funds proof exists in capture/PAS lane but not normal settlement lane.
deadEnds.expected: Normal settlement has its own negative-path proof.

activeOwner.note: P-025 owns canonical integration, payment authority, actor authority, and security reconciliation.

deadEnds.title: Receipt capture can create unreviewed wrong truth
deadEnds.problem: OCR or extraction can fail or hallucinate, and the current behavior model has no proven user review/correction proof for capture truth.
deadEnds.expected: Capture output is always draft until Mina reviews amount, merchant, payer, split, and receipt confidence.

deadEnds.title: Receipt and spend amount mismatch has no resolution path
deadEnds.problem: A receipt amount can conflict with a spend-card/payment amount without a mapped resolution state.
deadEnds.expected: Mismatch becomes an explicit review/dispute state and cannot send payment requests until resolved or annotated.

deadEnds.title: Duplicate receipt can double-charge group
deadEnds.problem: The capture map has no proven duplicate-detection path for re-uploaded receipts or repeated spend imports.
deadEnds.expected: Duplicate capture is detected or shown as a possible duplicate before it affects balances.

deadEnds.title: Sensitive receipt details can leak to payers
deadEnds.problem: Receipt capture can include private items, addresses, card fragments, or sensitive merchant details without a mapped redaction/share boundary.
deadEnds.expected: Mina can review/redact what payers see; saved record separates private proof from shared explanation.

deadEnds.title: Spend reversal after request can leave stale obligations
deadEnds.problem: A card reversal/refund after requests are sent can leave stale or wrong payment obligations.
deadEnds.expected: Reversal creates a new open-balance review and follow-up request path without mutating already-sent requests silently.

deadEnds.title: Capture-to-close inherits normal closeout order bug
deadEnds.problem: Capture journeys still depend on the normal closeout ordering issue where confirmation can precede readable closeout review.
deadEnds.expected: Capture closes only after all items are resolved and Mina reviews the saved record.

laneVocabulary.rule: Every path has one routing category. Only unowned paths may be recommended for this task; proof remains surface-scoped.

activeLanes.note: Programme A owns portable-shell behavior and host proof. P-026 consumes its evidence only.
P-025 owns canonical integration, payment authority, actor authority, and security reconciliation.
This task owns structured proof mapping, generated queues, lane exclusions, and unowned-next routing only.

acceptedClaims: Manual amount and reason are the honest normal capture path.
ReviewSplit is the only normal screen that saves the spend.
Portable web and Telegram local journeys remained green.
excludedClaims: The superseded receipt/OCR candidate is current product proof.
Legacy/root receipt UI behavior is portable-shell behavior.

acceptedClaims: Live Paseo .dot host journey passed with 22 screenshots and reload persistence.
Live HTTPS Telegram-profile journey passed with 24 screenshots and a standalone payer packet.
Spend review, request, payer action, receiver confirmation, explicit finish, saved summary, and persisted return were exercised.
limitations: No completed live Product Account login.
Telegram proof used the host profile and HTTPS deployment, not a real Telegram client session.

acceptedClaims: The structured behavior-map architecture and generated rollup views are reusable P-026 machinery.
excludedClaims: Legacy/root C-003, C-004, and C-005 proof promotion.
Legacy/root D-019 as a portable-shell defect.
Any product implementation change from the dirty root.

routingContract.proofScopeRule: Proof is surface-scoped. Portable-shell evidence never promotes canonical/root web automatically.
routingContract.duplicateWorkRule: Paths marked active_elsewhere are excluded from this task's recommendation queue.
routingContract.stopCondition: P-026 maps and routes the next journey; it does not implement that journey.
